item.text:
The ResStock 2025 Release 1 heat pump water heater upgrade assumes:

- **Efficiency:** Uniform Energy Factor (**UEF ≥ 3.3**).
- **First hour rating:** **FHR ≥ 45 gal/h**.
- **Voltage:** **240V units only**. It explicitly excludes 120V HPWHs, even though those can also qualify for ENERGY STAR.

Source: [*ResStock Measure Documentation: Heat Pump Water Heater*, p. 2, “Technology Summary” and §1.1](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96826.pdf#page=10).
